mechanism_narrative: A low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS < 0.5%) compresses discount rates for equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as the monetary policy stance supports risk-taking.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 0.5%, or the Rank IC for FEDFUNDS is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A high unemployment rate (UNRATE > 6.0%) signals economic weakness and potential fiscal stimulus, which typically depresses equity valuations and produces negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE exceeds 6.0%, or the Rank IC for UNRATE is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in housing starts (HOUST < 1600.0 thousand units) indicates weakening consumer demand for housing, triggering negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as the housing sector is a key component of GDP.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of triggered instances (HOUST < 1600.0), or the Rank IC for HOUST is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the consumer price index (CPIAUCSL > 265.0) signals accelerating inflation, prompting the Fed to tighten policy and causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of triggered instances (CPIAUCSL > 265.0), or the Rank IC for CPIAUCSL is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate is low (FEDFUNDS < 0.5%) and unemployment is high (UNRATE > 6.0%), the combination signals a weak economy with accommodative monetary policy, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days due to reduced corporate earnings growth.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of triggered instances (FEDFUNDS < 0.5% AND UNRATE > 6.0%), or the Rank IC for the interaction term is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) decline below 1650.0 and industrial production (INDPRO) falls below 105.0, it indicates a broad-based economic slowdown, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as corporate profits face headwinds.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of triggered instances (HOUST < 1650.0 AND INDPRO < 105.0), or the Rank IC for the interaction term is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During a monetary tightening cycle (FEDFUNDS rising > 0.1% in 3 months), the S&P 500 experiences negative forward returns over the next 60 trading days as higher interest rates reduce equity valuations and corporate borrowing costs.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS has risen > 0.1% in 3 months, or the Rank IC for FEDFUNDS during tightening cycles is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a labor market slack regime (UNRATE > 6.0%), the Federal Reserve maintains accommodative monetary policy, supporting equity valuations and producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE exceeds 6.0%, or the Rank IC for UNRATE during slack labor markets is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
